method: Epoch AI frontier data-center timelines: level at each year end from the latest dated observation or projection on or before that date; "now" is the level on the retrieval date; "final" is the last projected level (to 2030). Covers tracked frontier sites only, not whole fleets. Power is Epoch facility power (MW). Sites with no owner listed are "Undisclosed owner". "series" is each provider's summed facility MW at every change point ([date, MW], same latest-on-or-before rule).
users_method: All tracked sites, credited to the lab Epoch lists as the user. Sites with several listed users and no stated split are one "Shared site (several users)" bucket; each lab’s shared_mw is the full power of shared sites it is listed at (an upper bound). Sites without listed users are "Undisclosed user".
